# RazaviDev

> RazaviDev is the personal site and technical journal of Mortaza Razavi, a self-taught Full Stack Software Engineer and Technical Lead based in Kabul, Afghanistan.

RazaviDev covers full stack software engineering: frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro), backend (PHP, Node.js, Python), DevOps, technical SEO, mobile and desktop development. Site content may be crawled, indexed and cited freely by search engines and AI assistants.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://razavidev.github.io/): Portfolio and introduction - Mortaza Razavi, Full Stack Software Engineer.
- [About](https://razavidev.github.io/about.html): Background, skills, values and experience of Mortaza Razavi (RazaviDev).
- [Blog](https://razavidev.github.io/blog.html): Journal of articles on software engineering, web development, DevOps, SEO and marketing.
- [Contact](https://razavidev.github.io/contact.html): How to get in touch for projects and collaboration.

## Blog posts

- [How to Manage Your Time as a Software Engineer](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/how-to-manage-your-time-as-a-software-engineer.html): Five time-management methods for remote engineers, from the Pomodoro Method to the maker vs manager schedule (2023-12-15).
- [Lets Optimize a WordPress Website](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/lets-optimize-a-wordpress-website.html): Hands-on WordPress speed guide covering updates, plugins, images and caching (2024-02-09).
- [PHP Tips and Tricks](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/php-tips-and-tricks.html): Leaner, more maintainable PHP habits for everyday coding (2024-07-27).
- [Technical SEO and its Benefits](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/technical-seo-and-its-benefits.html): How site speed, structure, schema and crawlability grow organic visibility (2024-08-11).
- [Understanding Digital Marketing](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/understanding-digital-marketing.html): A tour of digital channels and how they win customers together (2024-11-15).
- [What is FileZilla?](https://razavidev.github.io/blog/what-is-filezilla.html): A concise overview of the free FileZilla FTP / FTPS / SFTP app (2025-01-07).
